raw_text: Please also reference @.agents/memories/20-tooling.md as needed. `.rulesync/` is the source of truth; author changes in `rules`, `skills`, `subagents`, `commands`, `hooks`, and `mcp` there first. Regenerate artifacts; do not hand-edit generated target directories. Keep shared root `AGENTS.md` content in this overview rule; keep follow-up split rules off AGENTS-writing targets. Keep frontmatter strictly RuleSync-compliant. Keep commands deterministic, keep hooks advisory. Validate and regenerate with the system-wide `rulesync` binary: use `rulesync generate --check` as the consistency gate, then `rulesync generate` when changes are intentional. Review source and generated diffs together. **Verify target configurations** using the per-target checklists in `.rulesync/verification/` before committing changes. Tab cycles **primary** agents only. `<REDACTED_USER>` invokes subagents. If RuleSync reports `Multiple root rulesync rules found`, ensure only one root overview rule exists. Use RuleSync commands directly instead of manually reproducing catalog, prompt, incident, or graph logic.
